description: “After much prayer and consideration with my family, I have decided to file for re-election,” said Rep. Bell. “It is truly an honor and privilege to serve the citizens of eastern North Carolina in the state legislature. While the district lines are changing, I want to thank the people of Greene County and eastern Johnston County for the opportunity to represent them over the past eight years.”
paid_for_by: PAID FOR BY ELECT JOHN BELL COMMITTTEE
title: John Bell Files for Re-Election
